description: DRAFT (TASK-0055): stage C3+C4 of the T12 calibration (spec v0.27 §8.2 p.4, #177); model JetSliceCalib. Phase A = 45 points (series 'C3C4-A/k=*', walk order = file order: K_DIV outer, H_MAX, THETA_START 0.6/0.3/0.9). Phase B (KAPPA_Q10) series are appended by the rule after phase A. A point: 'matrix --manifest this --point P' (its 100 calibration seeds) -> 'exp0002.py --calib DIR --point P' (C4) + 'c3-stand --manifest this --point P' (C3). Not frozen.

meta.protocol: Frozen values of the EARLIER stages go into the top-level 'params' of this manifest (a revision with a new manifest_hash, recorded in 'journal'); the series sweep only this stage's own keys, so the manifest stays valid after every freeze. Spec v0.27 §8.2 p.4; lab-cli.md 'Точки калибровки T12'.
meta.phase_B: if no phase-A point has L_stage = 0: series 'C3C4-B/rank=r' (r = 1..3, the best phase-A points by L_stage, tie: walk order) with params {K_DIV, H_MAX, THETA_START} of that point and sweep {KAPPA_Q10: [0, 256, 768, 1024]}, appended before any phase-B evaluation
